relations.rationale: Sitting together during lunch supports the possibility they talked and compared notes then.
Kai sitting with Vik at lunch is unrelated to Sami helping fix a wheel axle.
Kai and Vik comparing notes at lunch is unrelated to Vik's reaction during the race later.
Comparing notes at lunch has no bearing on the group sweeping the floor at the end.
Lunch conversation about sensors is unrelated to later talk about the next session.
Isla checking on progress during lunch is unrelated to Kai's ranking in the race afterward.
Sami fixing a loose axle sets up the situation where the axle could pop off again, supporting the later event.
Noise and clapping filling the room in early afternoon aligns with and supports the idea that teams were racing machines then.
Teams racing machines provides the context in which Vik's enjoyment of competition could be observed, supporting it.
The race described supports the scenario where Vik's robot inches ahead and he grins.
The race provides the event in which Kai could be ranked fastest overall, supporting that claim.
Vik enjoying the competition most is consistent with and supports him grinning as his robot inches ahead.
Vik's enjoyment of competition is unrelated to the group sweeping the floor afterward.
Vik grinning as his robot inches ahead suggests some speed differences existed, which is compatible with but not strongly supporting the claim that differences were agreed to be small.
Vik's grinning during the race is unrelated to the group sweeping the floor later.
Kai ranking fastest overall is compatible with everyone agreeing the speed difference was small, suggesting a close race.
Both describe simultaneous wind-down activities, so packing away tools supports the coexisting act of sweeping the floor together.
Packing away tools as the workshop ends is consistent with and supports the idea that the group was already discussing the next session.
Sweeping the floor together as the workshop ends supports the idea that they were also talking about the next session at that time.
